text: Added neuroim2 only under Suggests and two narrow adapters: neuroim2_volume_domain() records full-volume feature indices plus spatial metadata; neuroim2_searchlights() consumes only neuroim2::searchlight_indices(), maps full indices to compact ordered feature columns, and returns the standard sparse additive frame. No ROI, extraction, result, or parallel machinery crosses the boundary. Adapter records upstream commit 77b1ddb.
